text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Hokko Tarumae was preparing a 
campus guide for young Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, dirt tracks are the main focus 
of that session, and it seems they asked 
Espoir City, who happened to have free 
time, to lend a hand, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm. Not. Doin'. It~!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I've got time to play kids' 
games like that!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Still... this is a chance to convey the 
appeal of dirt racing to future students!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If we can showcase ourselves, it'll help 
both the Academy and the dirt circuit we 
run in! So, Espo-san, you should too—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Shut up! Go ask someone else! I ain't the 
academy's errand girl!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the day of the campus 
tour arrived. Hokko Tarumae stood alone 
before the group of little kids.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to Tracen Academy, everyone! I'm 
Hokko Tarumae, and I'll be your guide.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Today's academy tour will mainly focus on 
the dirt tracks. We'll be bringing you 
plenty of highlights!"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt... If it was for the academy 
brochure, I really wish I was featured in 
a turf-focused edition..."

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped~. The turf slot was 
super popular, so it was already over 
capacity...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
C-Calm down, everyone! Please make sure to 
enjoy your time at the academy today!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha. ...They're totally looking down on us, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Told you, it's got nothing to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"This is the academy's gym. We're always 
installing and maintaining the latest 
state-of-the-art machines!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To avoid getting caught in the sand, let's 
thoroughly train your muscles and core!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Sand~? ...So, does that mean you don't 
need us?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Dirt is all about muscle, turf 
is all about speed! ...Or so I heard~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Umm...! R-Regardless of distance or 
surface, physical conditioning is 
essential! Every Umamusume uses these 
facilities!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes the tour. Thank you very 
much for your time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, to show my gratitude... I'll 
actually run on the dirt in my racewear! 
Please wait just a moment while I get 
ready!"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a long one~.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Is that big sister gonna run from here~? 
...Ugh, I'm already bored of the dirt 
track...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whaddya say, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Hey!! You little brats!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm... the academy's guide from the 
shadows!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you dare underestimate her, got 
it?! Her running... I'm gonna give you a 
play-by-play right before your eyes!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! Immediately adjust your position 
after the start! It's tough to make a late 
charge on dirt, right?! As expected of an 
honor student—she's already looking ahead!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
""...Ah, now that you mention it...!"" 
""R-Right, right! So that's why it 
moved...""

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And! That mid-race hill is a battle of 
pure guts, damn it! Even if the dust 
blinds me, my legs won't stop! —I'm 
carrying the pride of Tomakomai on my 
shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"She's not exhausted at all...!?" "Whoa... 
and that slope is super steep, too~!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"The finish! Squeezing out every ounce of 
their soul—and across the goal!!! This 
isn't just about raw power... Dirt racing 
is a clash of true determination, you hear 
me!?"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Wa... Waaaah!!" "I... I'm so moved...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... This is... what actual 
running... is like!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah~!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"T-That... was so cool!!" "Incredible 
tenacity...!" "I wanna be a Dirt Champion 
too~!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What?! Th... Thank you so much! I had no 
idea you were enjoying it that much...!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! An orange-haired big sis taught me a 
whole bunch of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...The orange-haired big sister did?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ......Huh? She's already gone...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ………… Thank you... very much, Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Those runts are taking the 
dirt way too lightly!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Tarumae, don't just let them 
say whatever they want! Hmph!

and your friends...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah!? D-Don't get the wrong idea!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I was just... pissed off, alright?! You 
pick a fight with me, like hell I'm gonna 
stay quiet!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: !? No... It's not like I care or anything!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Defend your own damn pride yourselves! 
...That's all I'm saying!"
